planets.name: KELT-8 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-8 with a 3.24-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: KELT-8 b was found in 2015 by KELT as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-8. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
